Background

Engineered for the Frame

Born in Kannur and raised in Wayanad, Jins carried an engineer's discipline through Mar Athanasius College of Engineering and into a software career at TCS, Chennai — before relocating to Kochi to chase acting full time.

Since his debut in Swapna Sanchari (2011) and his breakthrough as Jismon in Rajeev Ravi's Annayum Rasoolum (2013), Jins has built a career on authority figures and grounded characters — working alongside Fahadh Faasil, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Kunchacko Boban, and Jayasurya.
